rules: Only an explicitly stated future action is included.
A speaker saying 'I will' establishes an owner; collective 'we still need to' does not identify one person.
No calendar due date may be invented. A stated ordering condition is preserved as a deadline condition.
Open questions are not duplicated as actions unless the transcript also states a concrete follow-up action.
limitations: This is a single-author synthetic development fixture, not double-annotated real-customer Ground Truth.
